t2.thesis: Base rate tilt toward a rise is offset by UBER's poor recent earnings-day record, a stock already down heavily, and mixed event risk (Delivery Hero deal, robotaxi, regulatory), leaving roughly a coin flip.
reasons: Last 4 prints: only 1 of 4 positive open-to-open returns (win rate 0.25), with reactions averaging negative even on EPS beats
Implied move about 7.8% with ATM IV near 2.9x realized vol; elevated event premium, but symmetric and no directional signal
Stock is 33% off its 52w high and -31% over 12m, so expectations are low and sentiment is bearish, which can support a relief move
Guidance in Aug was strong (GB +18-22%, EPS +28-35%), analysts bullish (rec mean 1.58) but the Delivery Hero acquisition and debt financing add overhang
Entry is the open of Nov 3, so the pre-earnings run-up day is included; midterm election Nov 3 adds macro noise
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 gross bookings guidance and Q3 adjusted EBITDA versus consensus, plus commentary on the Delivery Hero deal financing and autonomous vehicle competition.

prior.from: I3 BMO session base rate 0.548 (overall validation 0.542; consumer cluster 0.555; software_internet 0.541)

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-11-02, so the November 4, 2026 earnings report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how UBER's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Down about 5 points from 0.55 to 0.50: weak earnings-day history and deal/robotaxi/regulatory overhang offset the base rate and low-expectation setup.

theses.expected: Rise: Q3 beats with strong Q4 bookings guide in line or above, stock rebounds from depressed levels
theses.mechanism: Low expectations, 33% drawdown, and high IV crush with relief rally
theses.wrong_if: Gross bookings guide implies deceleration below 18% constant currency or EBITDA guide is light

theses.expected: Fall: guidance merely in line, with Delivery Hero deal costs and robotaxi fears dominating
theses.mechanism: Pattern of negative reactions on past prints despite beats; investors sell on capital allocation concerns
theses.wrong_if: Management shows leverage and buyback support alongside upbeat AV partnership commentary

theses.expected: Flat or small move: the 7.8% implied move overstates the realized reaction
theses.mechanism: Implied move is rich versus 60d realized vol, so realized move may be smaller and direction is dictated by modest guide changes
theses.wrong_if: A large surprise in bookings or regulatory news triggers a move beyond 8%

key_observations: Q4 gross bookings and EBITDA guidance versus consensus
Mobility and Delivery gross bookings growth and trips growth
Delivery Hero offer status, financing, and leverage commentary
AV partnerships and robotaxi competition remarks
Buyback pace and free cash flow
